request: New York JFK to Singapore on March 15th for the Asia-Pacific engineering review, business class please. My supervisor already signed the printed itinerary for the business fare.

must_keep.quote: • For flights with a segment of 10 hours or more in duration, an employee may select business class.
must_keep.why: business class may be selected for a segment of 10 hours or more

must_keep.quote: Airline tickets totaling $7,500 USD or greater will need a supervisor approval prior to the ticket being purchased. The employee is required to included proof of supervisor approval prior to purchase of ticket. This can be done by printing a copy of the itinerary and having the supervisor sign off prior to purchase.
must_keep.why: a ticket of $7,500 or more needs a supervisor's approval before purchase

must_keep.quote: Travelers are required to accept the lowest logical airfare available.
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest logical airfare

design_notes: A 1,110-minute nonstop allows business (lines 139-140). The business ticket is $8,120, $7,500 or greater, so it needs a supervisor approval before purchase (lines 125-128); the supervisor's sign-off on the printed itinerary is on file, so book it. The approver is the supervisor whose sign-off is on file, or NONE (SYNC_NOTES 4': a sign-off already on file reads both ways).
